title: Experiment-aware tenant-route attribution mart and sparse attribution indexes
creator: Ava Patel
description:
Problem: Product and Growth need reliable attribution for A/B experiments and feature flags tied to specific routes and models. Current console usage tables only expose route and workspace activity; they do not capture experiment exposure or map exposures to per-invocation costs. This ticket builds a dedicated attribution mart that joins call-level events with experiment exposure metadata and workspace membership to produce experiment-aware rollups and sparse indexes for fast per-experiment cost and metric queries.

Scope:
- Design schema for the attribution mart (hourly and daily rollups + a compact per-invocation staging table).
- CDC-friendly ETL that supports idempotent upserts, de-dup, and late-arriving experiment signals.
- Sparse indexing strategy for (tenant_id, route_id, experiment_id) to keep storage bounded.
- Materialized views for common queries: per-experiment cost, conversion funnel, and latency percentiles.
- Backfill plan and migration path from existing console usage tables.

Success criteria: product can reliably answer: (a) total token cost by experiment over a time window, (b) per-route experiment exposure counts, (c) experiment lift on latency and error rates, with less than 10% query tail latency vs current ad-hoc approaches.
acceptance_criteria: Hourly attribution rollup populated for last 14 days and visible in 'analytics.experiment_attribution_hourly'
Daily compact mart available for 90-day retention with sparse indexes for fast filtering
ETL idempotency verified with dedup tests and reconciliations (replay ingestion produces no double-counting)
Dashboards: 'Experiment cost & exposure' and 'Experiment route performance' exist and show expected numbers for 3 pilot experiments
Backfill completed without blocking console queries (staged rollout strategy executed)
tasks: Design schema and column-level contracts (SCD strategy for tenant/workspace membership)
Develop join enrichment job to attach experiment exposures (airflow: enrich_experiment_exposures)
Build hourly rollup materialized view and sparse index population job
Create migration and backfill playbook; run in dry-run then production
Author dashboards and smoke tests; pair with PM/Analytics for validation
Add monitoring alerts for ETL lag, row growth, and reconciliation diffs
implementation_plan: Phase 1: Staging and schema design (2 wks) - create 'staging.attribution_invocations' table, define dedup key as (call_id). Phase 2: Enrichment (1 wk) - join experiments-service exposures and workspace membership; store exposures as experiment_id and cohort_id. Phase 3: Rollups (2 wks) - hourly materialized view: group by tenant_id, route_id, experiment_id, hour; compute cost_tokens, invocation_count, median_latency_approx. Use sparse partitioning by experiment_id hash. Phase 4: Backfill & validation (1 wk) - run backfill for last 90 days in dry-run, compare totals vs canonical console usage. Phase 5: Rollout (1 wk) - promote DAGs, add dashboards and alerts.
tradeoffs:
Denormalized mart (store experiment_id on rollups) increases storage but simplifies queries for product/analytics. Alternative is to keep normalized joins at query time which reduces storage at the cost of high query CPU and complex joins across large tables. We chose denorm + sparse indexes because common queries are single-experiment slices; sparse indexing keeps per-experiment storage modest.

For latency-sensitive dashboards we precompute approximate median and p95 via t-digest sketches; this sacrifices exactness for query performance. If exact percentiles are required for audits, we will compute them on-demand in a separate slow job.
docs: Confluence: Experiment Attribution Mart Design (link above)
monitoring: Reconciliation drift > 1% vs canonical usage -> Slack #analytics-alerts
Row growth > expected per-tenant threshold -> create-ticket to re-evaluate sparse indexing
blockers: Experiments service does not yet expose per-invocation exposure_id consistently (ENG dependency)
Missing feature: workspace membership historical SCD export (need snapshot endpoint from account-service)
Quick query perf regressions in sandbox when joining big canonical tables (investigating materialized view tuning)

rollout_plan: 1) Run backfill in dry-run and generate reconciliation report. 2) If diffs < 0.5% approve production backfill. 3) Enable hourly rollup population DAG in a canary workspace group (5 pilot tenants). 4) Monitor dashboards and reconciliation metrics for 48h. 5) Gradually increase workspace coverage and then mark as default data source for experiment reporting.
notes: Keep the mart small by pruning experiments with no exposures after 30 days (TTL). Use hashed experiment_id -> mod 4096 partition for the sparse index to avoid huge single partitions. Coordinate with Privacy/Legal if experiments join with PII (we only store workspace_id and tenant_id).
